diagnostics.message: the header `Host` is geas's to set: geas only calls the service it started, and sends `Host: 127.0.0.1`
the header `connection` is geas's to set: geas makes one request on each connection, and sends `Connection: close`
the header `Content-Length` is geas's to set: geas counts the body and sends its length
the header `TRANSFER-ENCODING` is geas's to set: geas sends the body whole, with its length
